Reincorporation is a rebirth mechanic which will reset all of your progress and reward you with reincorporation score and reincorporation tokens. When a corporation reincorporates, they will receive a reincorporation score for every billion dollars of net worth (calculated at the time of reincorporation) as well as a reincorporation token and 1,000 Pass XP (during seasons) for every billion dollars of net worth up to 10x reincorporation tokens and 10,000 Pass XP.

However, premium members get a bonus to the number of reincorporation tokens they can get.

IdleCorp+ can get 15x reincorporation tokens and 15,000 Pass XP max. IdleCorp Gold can get 20x reincorporation tokens and 20,000 Pass XP max. IdleCorp Platinum can get 25x reincorporation tokens and 25,000 Pass XP max.

For example, if a corporation with a net worth of $15 billion decides to reincorporate, they will receive 15x reincorporation score, but only 10x reincorporation tokens and 10,000 Pass XP.

If that same corporation instead chose to get IdleCorp+, they can get the full 15x reincorporation tokens and 15,000 Pass XP!


If a corporation with a net worth of $5 billion decides to reincorporate, they will receive 5x reincorporation score and reincorporation tokens, along with 5,000 Pass XP.

Starting Land[edit]

When a corporation reincorporates, 10 free starting land will be granted in the region in which they issued the reincorporation command. This can be increased by unlocking bonuses in season pass.

Token Rewards[edit]

Land[edit]

A corporation can choose to spend a reincorporation token to receive 4x land at any time by issuing the following command: $$usetoken land

Land discount[edit]

A corporation can choose to spend a reincorporation token to receive a permanent (retained across reincorporations) discount on land costs. Each token spent will grant a discount of 2%. There is a total limit of 40 tokens for this reward for a maximum land discount of 80%. Corporations can redeem this reward by issuing the following command: $$usetoken land discount

If a corporation has multiple tokens that they wish to use at the same time, they can specify the number of tokens they wish to spend at the end of the command: $$usetoken land discount 8

Tech slots[edit]

A corporation can choose to spend 4x reincorporation tokens for a permanent tech slot by using the following command: $$usetoken tech slot

Blueprint[edit]

A corporation can choose to spend 12x reincorporation tokens for a wildcard blueprint by using the following command: $$usetoken blueprint
